name: Verne
sub: Rimac-born robotaxi operator contracted in eleven cities
regions: Croatia; Europe; Middle East, eleven contracted cities, talks with 30 worldwide
about: Robotaxi operator spun out of the Rimac Group to own and run autonomous ride services. Their first market is Zagreb with Uber and Pony.ai supplying the Gen-7 autonomy stack on Arcfox Alpha T5 EVs, with fare service targeted for the second half of 2026, Europe's first commercial robotaxi launch of its kind.
model: Owns and operates robotaxi fleets; rides distributed through the Uber app.
financing: Rimac Group backing plus Croatian and EU support; terms not fully public
deployment: Zagreb launch targeted H2 2026 pending approval; contracts to launch in eleven cities across Europe and the Middle East.
metrics: Launch timing pending regulation; high confidence on announcements. Partners aim to scale to thousands of vehicles; in talks with 30 cities worldwide.
signal: Europe's most concrete near-term robotaxi launch, an operator model pairing city contracts with imported autonomy.
